The negative word नञ् is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction, and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The समासान्त affix does not come after a तत्-पुरुष समास of words like राजन् etc. herein taught, when the negative particle न precedes them.

Terms: समासान्त

The affix अच् comes optionally after the words 1. हलि and 2. सक्थि final in a बहुव्रीहि समास when preceded by a negative particle or by the words 1. दुस् and 2. सु।

Terms: अच्

After a Negative Particle, in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of 1. जर 2. मर 3. मित्र and 4. मृत।

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term
The words formed with the तद्धित affixes denoting 'fitted for that' -- सम्पादिनि
, 'capable to effect that' -- तस्मै प्रभवति संतापादिभ्यः

, have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the Negative Particle नञ् , when it makes a negation with regard to the above mentioned attributes.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable of the compound.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The nasal of अञ्च् is not elided when meaning is to honour.

Terms: Nasal Elision

Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is always substituted for the first vowel of 1. शुचि 2. ईश्वर 3. क्षेत्रज्ञ 4. कुशल and 4. निपुण when preceded by the Negative particle, but this substitution is optional for the vowel of the Negative particles.

Terms: वृद्धि
